scope: Prepared late-Jigran records and fragment set. Actual LeaveToZone precedes all four rescue branches: each missing fragment blocks restoration and retains its other two; the complete set enables actual preceding/ritual/reunion dialogues and once-only Kel restoration with archived stats/equipment. Native AddLoot restores stored fragments after consuming the live set; the unsynchronized control has no stored fragments to restore. Save/load preserves both outcomes and current named-mercenary recalculation. Not a full island-to-island playthrough or native executable replay.
